name: critique@0.2.1
body:
1. **Review call-flow changes alongside line diffs** with experimental `--calldiff`. Changed call trees appear beneath their source files in the terminal, web previews, PDFs, and images. Only added calls and their parent functions appear.

   ```bash
   critique --calldiff
   critique main HEAD --calldiff --web "Call flow changes"
   ```

   Set `CRITIQUE_CALLDIFF=1` to enable it by default. It does not support `--staged`, `--stdin`, or `--watch`. First use can install a Tree-sitter grammar through npm.

2. **See the commits included in a diff before sharing it.** Summaries show commits, files, changed lines, the base, and uncommitted work. Direct comparisons of diverged branches identify reversed commits. The TUI also shows the list. JSON uploads include `commits` and `reversedCommits`, with the text summary sent to stderr.

   ```bash
   critique main HEAD --web "Branch changes"
   critique main HEAD --web "Branch changes" --no-commit-list
   ```

3. **Stage hunks by content-based IDs that survive unrelated edits.** Duplicate hunks use `.1`, `.2`, and so on. Old line-number IDs are no longer accepted. List again when nearby edits merge hunks.

   ```bash
   critique hunks list
   critique hunks add 'src/main.ts:@a1b2c3d4e5f6'
   ```

4. **Complete commands and options with Tab** using live shell completions.

   ```bash
   critique completions install
   critique completions uninstall
   ```

5. **Select Catppuccin Latte** with `critique --theme catppuccin-latte` or the `t` theme picker. Thanks @dohzya for #46!

6. **Keep experimental `review` out of the main command list.** Direct invocations still work.

7. **Keep syntax highlighting in partial diffs** that start inside template literals, inline snapshots, and block comments. Bare closing backticks and quoted backtick fragments now render correctly too.

8. **View large diffs and repos with external diff drivers reliably.** Larger diffs no longer hit the old process output limit, and external Git diff drivers no longer cause an empty `unknown +0-0` view.

9. **Find correct navigation keys in the README.** The docs now show `p`, `t`, `q`, `gg`/`G`, and half-page scrolling. They also clarify that `--web` uploads rather than creating local HTML.

Fixes https://github.com/remorses/critique/issues/45
Fixes https://github.com/remorses/critique/issues/48
